datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Kenya on a monthly basis (February, June, December 2018) through field assessments and integrated analysis of food security indicators. Geographic polygons represent administrative units classified into IPC phases indicating severity of acute food insecurity, with metadata on collection dates, scenarios, and assistance requirements.
